_comment: Defaults for the accommodation add-on. A site overrides any key in its app-custom-config.json.

accommodation-read.description: See accommodations, their owners and occupants, and assessments
accommodation-read.label: See accommodations

accommodation-billing-read.description: Read a unit's billing: where its invoices go and for what share, and its owners by identity @id with their shares. What the accounting add-on's invoice job asks
accommodation-billing-read.label: Read units' billing

accommodation-units-list.description: See the list of accommodations by street address, with no names: the unit choices on the Occupancy information form
accommodation-units-list.label: See the list of unit addresses

accommodation-self.description: See your own units: those you hold a current ownership or occupancy entry for, with their owners, occupants and where the invoices go. The add-on checks the entry on every request
accommodation-self.label: See your own accommodation

accommodation-manage.description: Manage the accommodation add-on: accommodations, owners and the directory import
accommodation-manage.label: Manage accommodations

accommodation-notices.description: Be told of residents' changes the board should know about: a change to where a unit's invoices go, and changes to occupants
accommodation-notices.label: Get accommodation notices

accommodation-billing-update.description: The treasurer or an owner changed where a unit's invoices go; who, the unit and how many addresses, never the addresses

audit.description: Billing changed by the treasurer or an owner

accommodation-occupant-update.description: An owner changed their occupant's phones, work details or emergency contact; who, the unit, the occupant and the field names, never the values

audit.description: Occupant contact details changed by an owner

accommodation-occupant-add.description: An owner added an occupant to their unit, with a new account when the person had none; who, the unit, the occupant's username and whether the account is new, never the details

owner.name: owner
owner.description: Owns an accommodation. Given and taken away by the accommodation add-on from the dated ownership entries

occupant.name: occupant
occupant.description: Lives in an accommodation. Given and taken away by the accommodation add-on from the dated occupancy entries

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Accommodation administration
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Admins see and manage accommodations, and get its notices. A site grants accommodation-read, accommodation-manage or accommodation-notices to its board or treasurer in its own policy.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Accommodation: the list of unit addresses
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Every visitor and every user may see the units by street address, to pick their unit on a form. Addresses only, never names.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Accommodation: every user's own units
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: A permission over a person's own records goes to every user through vault-owner (ngdpbase#1539). The add-on still checks that the person holds a current entry for the unit.
